hook: $7.99 stopped my Hemnes drawer bins from sliding

scenes.visual_prompt: Drawer opening fast, a plastic bin sliding and hitting the side wall
scenes.voiceover: Every plastic bin I put in a Hemnes drawer slid the second I opened it fast.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the smooth painted or stain-lacquered drawer interior surface
scenes.voiceover: The painted, stain-lacquered interior gives bin feet nothing to grip.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of light scuff marks on white-stain drawer paint near a bin corner
scenes.voiceover: Rigid organizer corners scuff the paint over time too, especially on white.

scenes.visual_prompt: Unrolling the BAGAIL liner and cutting it to length with scissors on the drawer bottom
scenes.voiceover: This non-adhesive liner cuts to fit both the 14-inch and 30-inch drawers.

scenes.visual_prompt: Placing bins on top of the liner, drawer opened fast, nothing shifts
scenes.voiceover: Non-adhesive means it won't pull the finish when you reposition it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Simple graphic overlay: one roll icon next to eight drawer icons
scenes.voiceover: One 10-foot roll covers roughly eight Hemnes drawer bottoms.

scenes.visual_prompt: Drawer closing smoothly, no sliding sound, CTA appears

caption: Every plastic organizer I owned slid across my Hemnes drawer the second I opened it fast — the lacquered finish has nothing for bin feet to grip. This $7.99 non-adhesive liner fixed it and stopped the corners from scuffing the paint. Link in bio. Contains affiliate links.
